description.value: Sushi Umi is an authentic Japanese restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, serving a full sushi menu with dine-in and online ordering. Lonsdale Avenue is a main commercial corridor on the North Shore, making this a convenient stop for cyclists travelling through the area. The restaurant accepts takeout orders directly through its website.
